punchline: Steve Jobs's list of reasons not to sell Pixar to Disney included Disney's own culture.
thirty_sec: Bob Iger wanted to buy Pixar, and Steve Jobs wrote Pros and Cons on a whiteboard at Apple. The Cons were longer: Disney's culture would destroy Pixar, and Iger's board would never allow it. Iger promised to protect Pixar's culture and offered Lasseter and Catmull Disney Animation. The all-stock deal, $7.4 billion, was approved 9 to 2.
